tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po gyi ljang lugs bcu bdun ma'i gtor bsngo bzhugs so// swasti/ mgon po gyi ljang lugs bcu bdun ma'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa ni/ gtor ma gur lcam dral la phul ba de ka'am yang na zlum gtor sku bag can bshams la/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje'i sa gzhir rwa gur me 'od dang bcas pa'i nang du bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang zur gsum pa zur gcig rang la bstan pa la sgo yod pa/ thod pa skam rlon gyi rtsig pa'i steng na/ mi rkang gi shar bu rgyu ma dang don snying gi drwa ba drwa phyed 'phyang ba/ rus pa'i dral mas phub cing / maṃ sa'i 'jim pas bsdams pa/ rdo rje dang tsit+ta'i tog can/ 'og gi sa gzhi rdo rje'i brag nag pos gtams pa'i steng na/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mthing ka gri gug gi rwa bas bskor ba/ de'i dbus gru gsum la zhing gnyis bsnol ba'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan/ rtsibs brgyad la nyi ma'i gdan/ dbus su hūm̐ las nag po chen po kyus bzhin la/ 'on kyang gri gug 'phyar thabs/ g.yon brkyang ba gaṇ+ḍi med pa/ rtsibs brgyad la pad nyi'i steng du ya dang ma rnams las shar du gshin rje ya ba ti dang / gshin rje pho nya mo/ lhor gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po dang / gshin rje che ba mo/ nub tu gshin rje tel pa dang / gshin rje be con ma/ byang du gshin rje glang mgo can dang / gshin rje lcags kyu ma/ byang shar du gshin rje ral pa tshar dgu dang / gshin rje dus mtshan ma/ nub byang du gshin rje dmigs pa dang / gshin rje zhags pa ma/ lho nub tu gshin rje phya sangs dang / lu gu brgyud ma/ shar lhor gshin rje mig dmar dang / 'bebs ma gnyis/ de rnams yab yum zhal sbyor/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngo skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba/ lus la rgyan cha med pa sbrul nag po se ral khar thogs pa/ ha ha zhes khro bo'i sgra chen po sgrogs shing / zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas me rlung dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ yum thams cad sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la stobs pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ yab kyi lce 'jibs pa/ gdug pa thams cad tshul bzhin du 'gugs ma/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas yab kyi g.yon brkyangs pa dang gshibs pa/ g.yon gyis yab kyi g.yas la 'khril zhing gnyis su med par bzhugs pa/ 'di dam pa kun dga' grags kyi lha bcu bdun gyi sgrub yig dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i gter las bshad/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ lha bcu bdun gyi ye shes pa spyan drangs bstims/ dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur bas lha thams cad la phrin las kyi ngo bo mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gtso bo la shā sa na srin gzugs kyis bstod 'khor rnams la/ thabs mthas snang stong sgyu ma'i gar/ /mi sdug khro bo'i cha lugs can/ /rngams pa'i dgra bo rdul du rlog /gshin rje'i gtso bo brgyad la bstod/ /shes rab bde stong khro mo'i sku/ /bgegs kun tshar gcod gri gug 'phyar/ /sgrub la brtse bas thod khrag bsnams/ /ma mo'i gtso mo brgyad la bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ ces pa 'di yang skyo mda' bsam 'grub gling pa'i sprul sku 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bstan 'dzin bzang pos bskul ngor sa skya pa kun blos/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i mgon pos dbang chen lnga'i ngag 'don bklag chog ma las bcu bdun ma'i mngon rtogs zur du phyung shing srung 'khor la tshigs bsdus byas nas sbyar ba dge /sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/
